faq.title: Quick answers, honestly given.
faq.intro: The questions we hear most often from founders, applicants and partners — and the straightest answers we can offer to each.

items.a: Anyone with a working idea and an inherent zeal to build a venture — students, faculty, alumni and outside founders are all welcome. We particularly encourage applicants from the North-East.

items.q: What kind of ideas does the centre support?
items.a: Technology-led ideas — deep tech, hardware, software platforms, embedded systems, knowledge-based products. The idea should have a credible path to becoming a commercially viable venture.

items.q: What support does the centre provide?
items.a: Workspace inside the Technology Complex, technical assistance, business mentoring, network access, and — subject to availability — a soft-loan facility.
Yes. Soft-loan support is available for qualifying incubatees, and we work with funding partners including the Technology Development Board and Startup India for further capital.

items.q: Do I need to be affiliated with IIT Guwahati?
items.a: No. While we have a strong link with the IITG community, we welcome founders from anywhere — particularly from across the North-East ecosystem.

items.q: How long is the incubation programme?
items.a: Programme length varies with the venture. Some incubatees graduate inside a year; others stay through multi-year R&D arcs. The arrangement is shaped to fit the work.
Head to the Apply page and submit your idea. Our team will review it and reach out for a conversation if it looks like a fit.
